description: Betaflight CLI and Meshtastic terminal for M5Stack Cardputer Zero

store.summary: Betaflight CLI and backups, plus Meshtastic mesh chat, on Cardputer Zero.
store.description: A pocket field terminal for FPV pilots and Meshtastic users. Connect a Betaflight flight controller over USB or UART for CLI commands, field checks, command completion, and configuration backup/restore. Motor and erase commands ask for confirmation; supported VTX hardware can use a verified pit-mode guard. Connect a separate radio running Meshtastic firmware for direct or broadcast chat, heard-node ages, routing acknowledgements, quick messages, and local transcripts. Add a GNSS receiver for position sharing, range and bearing to reported positions, and saved marks; calibrate the built-in compass for heading in Locate. Auto-share is opt-in and session-only. SOS broadcasts to the mesh channel, not emergency services. Runs locally without an account or internet connection. Props off. Data cable in. The laptop can stay home. Screenshots are software-rendered UI examples with simulated data.
